create.title: Full Abel recombination, common-profile self-return, and variable-mask obstruction
create.statement_tex: Fix A>0, N=floor(X), q=4N, K=sqrt(NM), M^(3/4)(log(2X))^A<V<=K, and M<=N^(1/2). Retain the literal D=d=L=1 coefficient on its inherited complete nonwrapping physical lift, with every zero-extended profile component, transition, asymmetric cell, half-open choice, hard endpoint, and complex phase. For every odd d|N and every frequency v, positive-prefix and negative-suffix Abel summation give exactly six lines: the positive right outer endpoint, positive moving atom, positive profile difference, negative left outer endpoint, negative moving atom, and negative profile difference. Both moving atoms have positive sign, and the six lines telescope separately to the original positive and negative rows, including empty and singleton blocks. Recombine before estimation. Complete half-period inversion with its exact exterior factor returns G_N(t)=1_(N|t)chi_4(t/N). Subtracting the whole zero and Nyquist rows exactly once gives T_int,U(V)=S_U(V)-Z_U(V)-F_U(V), with |Z_U|+|F_U|<<M^(-1/4)X^epsilon. Fixed-dilation support and inherited lift compatibility make the physical-lift indicator one; the cells x^2-x+1<=Nell<=x^2+x partition the positive integers. Hence kappa(ell)=floor(sqrt(Nell)+1/2) and r(ell)=kappa(ell)^2-Nell give S_U(V)=sum_ell chi_4(ell)w_U(ell)e(sqrt(Nell))1_(V<|r(ell)|<=2V), exactly the accepted Round-154 common-profile hard dyadic root-defect wave. This does not alter the two distinct boundary-frozen profiles in the isolated Round-158 moving trace. With w_U=M^(-3/4)wtilde_U, the desired scalar target X^epsilon is equivalent to raw M^(3/4)X^epsilon. The exact mask r=-delta(2kappa+delta) has moving strict V edges, closed 2V edges, and centered-cell clipping. Its shifted h=-1 Fourier mode retains chi_4 and is raw O(X^epsilon), but this closes one mode only. Ordinary Erdos--Turan plus second derivative has raw capacity M/Q+sqrt(KQ)+M/sqrt(K)+1 and requires M>=N^(2/3). Literal Vaaler/Fejer root incidence has error K/J+sqrt(V)+sqrt(M)+1; at J=KM^(-3/4), the favorable transformed pair gives N^(195/796)M^(1295/3184+epsilon) and needs M^1093>=N^780. The older M^703>=N^390 threshold belongs only to an easier fixed-boundary M/J model. The B-process returns stationary denominators 4m+/-1, points 4q_1^2N/d^2, and phases e(q_1^2N/d); incomplete quadratic completion has favorable raw capacity N^(1/2) and needs M>=N^(2/3). These are route-scoped upper capacities, not lower bounds or impossibility theorems. No audited source through 25 August 2026 proves the joint signed variable-mask estimate. No strict range beyond the fixed-polylogarithmic collar and no downstream target or exponent is obtained.
create.next_action: Freeze the exact six-line recombination and common-profile self-return. Do not split the six Abel terms again or repeat the reciprocal B-process without a new signed input. Prove the raw M^(3/4) common-profile variable-mask estimate beyond the fixed-polylogarithmic collar; in the named Fourier route the first missing input is signed hard-boundary incidence for V>M^(3/2), or a joint nonzero moving-mode estimate for V<=M^(3/2).

update.statement_tex: For the literal D=d=L=1 large-defect root wave, exact quotient projection and half-period completion are lawful only in the ambient rows. Termwise DFI owns fixed and polylogarithmic first collars but loses at V asymp sqrt(NM). The zero and Nyquist rows are target-safe. Round 158 exactly isolates the moving-cell trace with two boundary-frozen profiles, but that trace alone does not control the full matrix. Round 159 recombines the two outer, two moving, and two profile-difference Abel lines before estimation; they telescope for every d and v, and complete inversion returns exactly the accepted Round-154 common-profile root-defect wave after the whole zero and Nyquist rows are subtracted once. Thus there is no independent Abel seam in the full row. The first open theorem is the raw M^(3/4) chi_4-twisted common-profile variable-mask estimate beyond the fixed-polylogarithmic collar. The shifted h=-1 mode is safe, while ordinary discrepancy, literal root-incidence plus transformed exponent pairs, the reciprocal B-process, and incomplete quadratic completion have only out-of-cone route capacities. These are not lower bounds or universal impossibility results.
